title: node_position_world and node_position_view incorrectly always return (0,0,0) for World Coord Particles
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in 4.1.2.stable, 4.4.stable, 4.5.b5 (node_world_position was not accessible in visual shaders in the versions of Godot3 I tested) ### System information Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9700K CPU @ 3.60GHz (8 threads) ### Issue description In a shader, node_position_world and node_position_view only work when Local Coord is toggled on. When node_position_world or node_position_view is read in a World Position particle system, it always returns (0,0,0). I would expect both Local and World Coord particle systems to return exactly the same value as each other and exactly the same as a Mesh Instance using the same material. ### Steps to reproduce In MRP: - On the GPUParticles3D Node, Under the GPUParticle3D's Drawing Properties, toggle Local Coords on and off to see different behavior From an empty project: - Create a new particle system - Assign a Process Material - In Draw Pass, assign a new QuadMesh - For the quad's material, assign a new shader material using a Visual Shader - In the shader, output node_position_world or node_position_view as Albedo - Move the particle system off of the world origin into some position with positive XYZ values - Under the GPUParticle3D's Drawing Properties, toggle Local Coords on and off to see different behavior ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [mrp_node_position_bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21884806/mrp_node_position_bug.zip)
